articles.title: NASA’s Pandora Satellite, CubeSats to Explore Exoplanets, Beyond
articles.summary: A new NASA spacecraft called Pandora is awaiting launch ahead of its journey to study the atmospheres of exoplanets, or worlds beyond our solar system, and their stars. articles.title: International Space Station crew to return early after astronaut medical issue
articles.summary:
Washington, United States (AFP) Jan 8, 2026


 NASA crewmembers at the International Space Station will return to Earth within days after an astronaut suffered a health issue, the US space agency said Thursday, the first such medical evacuation in the orbital lab's history.
